name: Marika Mae Cusick
department: Department of Health Policy and Management
institution: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
intro: I apply computational health policy methods to inform decision-making, improve outcomes, and promote health equity in chronic disease.
about: I apply computational health policy methods to inform decision-making, improve outcomes, and promote health equity in chronic disease. I am a tenure-track Assistant Professor in the Department of Health Policy and Management at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.
background: I received my PhD in Health Policy from Stanford University. I also hold a BA in Statistical Science from Cornell University and an MS in Information Science for Health Tech from Cornell Tech.

themes.title: Chronic disease prevention
themes.text: Evaluating the health benefits, cost-effectiveness, and affordability of prevention strategies, with a focus on cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic health and chronic kidney disease.

themes.title: Algorithmic evaluation
themes.text: Examining how clinical algorithms and AI influence decision-making, health outcomes, and health disparities.

themes.title: Computational health policy methods
themes.text: Developing novel decision-modeling frameworks and fair regression techniques for health policy analysis.
